pr_title: fix(csv): handle empty SKU cells gracefully
pr_body:
When a sheet contains rows with blank SKU cells the CSV export throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sku')`. This change adds a defensive check before accessing the SKU property, substituting an empty string when the value is missing. The fix prevents the crash and ensures the export completes successfully.

- Guard against undefined SKU values
- Replace missing SKU with `''` to keep CSV format valid
- Add unit test for rows with empty SKU
- Update documentation of export behavior

Closes #1234
